newsitem.title: INDIA: Market will drive India reforms - Price Waterhouse.
newsitem.headline: Market will drive India reforms - Price Waterhouse.

text.p: Market forces will continue to drive India's economic reforms despite concerns about its momentum, the chairman of Price Waterhouse World Firm Ltd said on Tuesday.
"Market forces will drive reforms' growth irrespective of politics," Dominic Tarantino told reporters.
Tarantino said his firm's business -- accountancy, auditing and consultancy -- was growing fastest in the emerging markets including China, India, Eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union.
"It is predicted that the emerging markets will likely produce more than half of the world's economic output in about 10 years time," Price Waterhouse said in a statement.

Company officials said their Indian clients included car maker Maruti Udyog Ltd, the Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd and Orissa State Electricity Board, a state-run utility firm which was among the first to be privatised.
